note: No API keys were used. All models were invoked via the Claude Code CLI (`claude -p`) on the author's subscription, per the author's instruction; only Claude models were run. The CLI exposes no models-list endpoint, so availability was established by probing each candidate ID with a one-line prompt on 2026-09-23 (see models_available.json).
